limitations: No real model credentials are configured; all HTTP model responses are from a controlled local test server.
Controlled failure reproductions do not establish the cause of any official 0.1.5 result.
Communication values are local estimates, not official Replay results or scores.
The scheduling algorithms and route search budget are unchanged; CPU-dependent search cutoffs can yield different paths and communication estimates.
The fast-path latency comparison is one paired run after warmup, not a statistical benchmark.
Prompt byte reductions do not measure actual token savings on the platform.
A persistent model timeout can now add up to one second relative to the previous two-second default.
